mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community (user_id, title, content, created_at, community_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), #{communityType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community ORDER BY like_count DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community WHERE community_type = #{type} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, community_type AS communityType FROM community WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT community.id AS id, community.user_id AS userId, community.title AS title, community.content AS content, community.like_count AS likeCount, community.created_at AS createdAt, community.community_type AS communityType FROM community_like JOIN community ON community_like.community_id = community.id WHERE community_like.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY community_like.created_at DESC
